Load a Hugging Face embedding model outside the pinned list

Source: R/custom.R
load_custom.Rd

load_custom() loads a Hugging Face embedding model that is not in the pinned list, on a "trust on first use" basis. Many embedding models on Hugging Face publish an ONNX export of their encoder and a tokenizer.json; such a model can be used like a pinned one, but its configuration is not vouched for by the package: there is no pinned revision, no package-controlled hash, and no check that its embeddings match the reference implementation. The caller is responsible for the pooling rule, prefix and maximum length.

On first use it resolves the current revision (unless revision is given), downloads the ONNX graph and tokenizer, and records their sizes, hashes and the model's configuration in a local manifest; later loads verify the files against that manifest. A later load with the same revision given uses no network; with revision = NULL every call first asks Hugging Face for the current revision. Pooling and maximum length are read from the repository's Sentence-Transformers configuration when it has one and must be given otherwise; the embedding dimension is read from the ONNX graph.

The result is an sbert_model like the one load_model() returns, so encode(), topics() and every other verb accept it. For the pinned, verified models use load_model().

Usage

load_custom(
  id,
  revision = NULL,
  onnx_path = NULL,
  tokenizer_path = "tokenizer.json",
  pooling = NULL,
  prefix = NULL,
  max_length = NULL,
  cache_dir = default_cache_dir(),
  backend = "cpu",
  threads = 1L,
  verify = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

id

Hugging Face repository id, for example "thenlper/gte-small".

revision

Commit hash to pin, or NULL (default) to resolve the current revision online on every call. Pin it for offline reuse.

onnx_path

Path of the ONNX graph in the repository, or NULL (default) to use onnx/model.onnx or model.onnx.

tokenizer_path

Path of the tokenizer in the repository (default "tokenizer.json").

pooling

"mean" or "cls", or NULL (default) to read it from the repository's 1_Pooling/config.json.

prefix

Text prepended to every input by encode(). NULL (default) keeps the recorded prefix ("" on first use); "" clears it.

max_length

Maximum word pieces per input, or NULL (default) to read it from sentence_bert_config.json, else 512.

cache_dir

Cache root (default cache_dir()).

backend

ONNX execution backend, as accepted by onnxr::onnx_model() (default "cpu").

threads

Number of inference threads (default 1).

verify

Check recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes when loading from the cache (default TRUE).

quiet

Suppress the download message and progress (default FALSE).

Value

An object of class sbert_model with the same fields as load_model() returns; its short_name is "custom:<id>".

Conditions

sbert_runtime_missing when ONNX Runtime is not installed; sbert_missing_package when jsonlite is not installed; sbert_download_failed when repository metadata or files cannot be downloaded or the revision cannot be resolved; sbert_model_error when the repository has no ONNX graph at the expected path, the pooling rule cannot be detected and was not given, or the graph lacks a last_hidden_state output or needs unsupported inputs; sbert_cache_invalid when cached files no longer match the recorded manifest.

See also

load_model() for the pinned models; install_runtime() for ONNX Runtime; encode() to use the model; cache_dir() for where it is stored.

Examples

# Custom models are stored under "custom" in this cache root.
cache_dir()
#> [1] "/home/runner/.cache/R/sbert"

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  model <- load_custom("thenlper/gte-small")
  encode(c("one sentence", "another sentence"), model)
}
# }
